modes.name: core-headless
modes.description: Core simulation only, no modules in use (headless server or batch run).

modes.name: physics-3d
modes.description: 3D game: character controller, dynamic bodies, jumps, sounds, random player input.

modes.name: planet-3d
modes.description: Round world: point gravity, planet character with jetpack, falling crates, navigation agents and physics walkers, random player input.

modes.name: planet-crowd
modes.description: Round world crowd: 2,000 navigation agents crossing a planet round obstacles.

modes.name: physics-2d
modes.description: 2D game: 2D physics, character controller, random player input.

modes.name: scripted
modes.description: Game logic in TypeScript scripts (hooks, engine API, seeded randomness).

modes.name: coop-netplay
modes.description: Networked co-op scene: per-player actions (p<slot>.*) and the NetPlayers roster read by scripts (decision 0211).

modes.name: scripted-spawning
modes.description: Scripts that spawn, clone and destroy entities and run timers (entity churn over a long run).

modes.name: render-3d
modes.description: 3D rendering: PBR models, lights, offscreen frame every tick.

modes.name: render-3d-lighting
modes.description: 3D rendering with every opt-in look: shadows, point and spot lights, sky light, emissive, tone mapping, fog.

modes.name: render-3d-looks
modes.description: 3D rendering with bloom, point and spot light shadows, environment reflections and sky background, glTF emissive (decisions 0064 to 0067), both eyes of an emulated headset.

modes.name: render-3d-raytracing
modes.description: 3D rendering with ray-traced shadows and reflections where the GPU has ray queries, else shadow cascades, a reflection probe and the rest of the fallback; HDR environment file (decisions 0090 to 0093), both eyes of an emulated headset.

modes.name: render-3d-play
modes.description: 3D game played with random input and rendered every tick (the windowed loop without a window).

modes.name: render-2d
modes.description: 2D rendering: batched sprites.

modes.name: render-2d-play
modes.description: 2D game played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: render-ui
modes.description: UI-heavy screen: panels, text and buttons in screen space.

modes.name: animation
modes.description: Skeletal animation: glTF clips on the fixed tick, scripted clip blending, GPU skinning and blend shapes, rendered every tick.

modes.name: blend-and-sound
modes.description: Blend spaces with phase sync, a masked additive overlay, an orbiting 3D sound and layered music driven by scripts, rendered every tick.

modes.name: vr-headset
modes.description: VR: the 3D game played with random input and rendered to both eyes of an emulated headset every tick.

modes.name: xr-play
modes.description: XR gameplay: scripted tracked poses grab and throw a block, random controller input on top, both eyes rendered every tick.

modes.name: factory-sim
modes.description: Factory simulation at 4x stress (952 machines, belts and items) on the job system, headless.

modes.name: factory-vr
modes.description: Factory at 1x rendered to both eyes of an emulated headset (instanced items, stereo).

modes.name: job-swarm
modes.description: Job TypeScript from scene data and scripts: 4,096 particles stepped by a JobSchedule every tick, seeded and summed through engine.jobs, headless.

modes.name: job-swarm-render
modes.description: The job swarm drawn every tick from its job arrays (JobDraw, one instanced batch) with shadows.

modes.name: proof-lantern-keeper
modes.description: Proof game 1 (top-down 2D, scripted): played with random input, headless.

modes.name: proof-lantern-keeper-render
modes.description: Proof game 1 played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: proof-cloudstep
modes.description: Proof game cloudstep: played with random input, headless.

modes.name: proof-cloudstep-render
modes.description: Proof game cloudstep played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: proof-ember-run
modes.description: Proof game ember-run: played with random input, headless.

modes.name: proof-ember-run-render
modes.description: Proof game ember-run played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: agent-session
modes.description: AI-driven building: a live session stepped, observed, edited, snapshotted and restored through operations (CLI and MCP run the same code).

modes.name: proof-crystal-ward
modes.description: Proof game 4 (top-down 3D: waves of spawned enemies, projectiles, messages): played with random input, headless.

modes.name: proof-crystal-ward-render
modes.description: Proof game 4 played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: proof-dust-circuit
modes.description: Proof game 5 (racing: script-driven cars, AI rival, checkpoints): played with random input, headless.

modes.name: proof-dust-circuit-render
modes.description: Proof game 5 played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: proof-signal-yard
modes.description: Proof game 6 (first-person shooter: ray-cast shots, drones, projectiles, mouse look): played with random input, headless.

modes.name: proof-signal-yard-render
modes.description: Proof game 6 played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.name: starter-maze-2d
modes.description: Game starter, maze template in 2D (made from a prompt, placeholder art): played with random input, headless.

modes.description: Game starter, maze template in 2D (made from a prompt, placeholder art): played with random input and rendered every tick.

modes.description: Game starter demo, maze template in 3D (models, shadows, bloom): played with random input and rendered every tick.
